title: ApexTrade
description: Normalised structured record of a single observed Apex trade, parsed from a backtest, journal, or report.

strategy.description: Internal strategy ID if identifiable from comment/magic number, else null. See docs/Strategy_Map.md.

exit.description: Exit price, if the trade has closed.

sl.description: Stop loss price at open (or at time of parsing, if it moved). Null if not present in the source report's Deals table (SL/TP are often only recorded on the Orders table).

trail.description: Observed trailing distance in points/pips, if trailing behaviour was detected. See docs/Trailing_Stop.md.

comment.description: Raw order comment or magic number as recorded by MT5.

duration_minutes.description: Trade duration in minutes, derived from time/close_time.

source.description: Evidence.md ID this trade was parsed from, e.g. 'E-014' or a descriptive tag like 'backtest2025'.
